basic_details.notification_number: Not mentioned in the official notification

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project associate (stereo eeg): B.E/B.Tech in engineering (4Y) or B.S/M.S. (5 years) or M.Sc (2Y) in Data Science, Computer Science, Biomedical Informatics, Biostatistics, Life Sciences or an equivalent stream is required. Candidates with at least 2–5 years of professional experience in data management within a hospital and/or biomedical research environment are preferred.

salary_details.details: The position is full-time and contractual, based in IISc, Bengaluru. The initial contract is for six months and will be renewed annually based on performance.

selection_process: The selection process involves screening of applications based on qualifications and experience.
how_to_apply: Prepare your Curriculum Vitae or Resume.
Write a 500-word paragraph explaining why you are uniquely qualified for the job.
Gather the name and address of two referees.
Compose an email with the subject line “[AMRIT] Application for Project Associate (stereo EEG)”.
Send the email to [email protected] on or before 18/10/26.
important_instructions: The position requires a considerable amount of travel to clinical partner hospitals (Deenanath Mangeshkar Hospital, Pune; Amrita Hospital, Kochi; Sri Chitra Hospital, Trivandrum, MS Ramaiah Hospital, Bengaluru, and others) with a few multi-day visits per month. There is a possibility for a full-time posting at one of the partner hospitals coupled with visits to other hospitals on availability of scheduled surgeries. Applications must be sent via email on or before 18/10/26.
